us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump to open Freedom 250 IndyCar race through Washington
bullets: President Donald Trump and Melania Trump were scheduled to attend Sunday’s race.
The course runs through downtown Washington near major landmarks.
The event is part of America’s 250th birthday celebrations.

articles.title: Nevada’s Hawk Fire grows beyond 10,500 acres near Reno
bullets: The wind-driven brush fire expanded to 10,523 acres by Saturday evening.
Reno police directed residents to evacuation information from Perimeter Map.
Gov. Joe Lombardo declared a state of emergency in Washoe County.

articles.title: Officials warn wildland firefighters about unproven smoke-exposure supplement
bullets: Fire and medical officials warned about glutathione use after wildfire smoke exposure.
At least two pharmacies recalled the supplement in August over contamination concerns.
The International Association of Firefighters said glutathione is not FDA-approved.

articles.title: Paramount and California to discuss Warner Bros. deal lawsuit
bullets: Paramount and California officials are expected to hold preliminary talks Monday.
The talks concern California’s lawsuit challenging Paramount’s Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition.
California and 11 states sued last month to block the $110 billion deal.

articles.title: US begins process to repay $725 million of UN debt
bullets: The Trump administration started transferring $725 million to the United Nations.
The payment was described in a State Department notification to Congress.
The amount is less than one-fifth of more than $4 billion the UN said the US owed in May.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide stories and geopolitical developments

articles.title: Zelenskyy details rift with dismissed defense minister
bullets: Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Mykhailo Fedorov’s actions after dismissal were misguided.
He cited concerns over protests, election calls and defense spending decisions.
Zelenskyy also warned Ukraine faces a shortage of Patriot missiles.

articles.title: Norway plans more than $9 billion in Ukraine aid for 2027
bullets: Norway plans 85 billion crowns, or about $9.2 billion, in Ukraine support for 2027.
The aid is intended for military and humanitarian spending.
Nordic and Baltic leaders visited Kyiv on Sunday in a show of support.

articles.title: Kazakhstan votes in snap election expected to strengthen Tokayev
bullets: Kazakhs began voting Sunday in a snap parliamentary election.
Reuters reported the vote is expected to tighten President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev’s power.
The election follows constitutional changes that streamlined parliament.

articles.title: Canada to retaliate after US tariff talks fail
bullets: Prime Minister Mark Carney said Canada would match new US tariffs dollar for dollar.
The retaliatory tariffs are scheduled to begin September 8.
The move followed failed trade talks with Washington.

articles.title: Syria expects Israel security talks to resume despite mistrust
bullets: Syria’s foreign minister said talks with Israel on a security deal could resume soon.
The discussions follow Israeli strikes and Damascus’s calls for withdrawal from Syrian land.
The minister said diplomacy remains possible despite lack of trust.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from national and regional sources

articles.title: Search continues after bulk carrier sinks off India’s east coast
bullets: A Panama-flagged cargo ship sank in the Bay of Bengal with 24 crew aboard.
India’s Coast Guard and Navy continued search-and-rescue operations Sunday.
Two Chinese crew members were rescued from life rafts.

articles.title: Agartala floods force evacuations after Haora River rises
bullets: Heavy overnight rain pushed the Haora River above danger level in Agartala.
Floodwaters entered homes in the Chandrapur-Baldakhal area late Saturday.
Authorities intensified rescue and relief operations in low-lying areas.

articles.title: RTI data shows 8.23 lakh central government posts vacant
bullets: An RTI response found 8,23,656 sanctioned civilian posts vacant.
Only 30,99,556 employees were in position against 39,23,212 sanctioned posts.
The data does not include vacancies in public sector banks or PSUs.

articles.title: BJP joins calls for Bhagwant Mann’s resignation over allegations against wife
bullets: The BJP demanded Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann resign over allegations involving his wife.
The allegation concerns a claimed Rs 5 crore demand to suppress a rape case.
AAP’s women wing chief dismissed the allegations as baseless.

articles.title: ISRO targets first Gaganyaan uncrewed launch within four months
bullets: ISRO Chairman V Narayanan said the first uncrewed Gaganyaan mission is in its final leg.
He said 8,000 tests have been completed for the human spaceflight programme.
ISRO is targeting eight launch vehicle missions in the current financial year.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Market movers and notable equity catalysts

articles.title: Walmart selloff weighs on retail sentiment after slower sales growth
bullets: Walmart shares fell sharply after a quarterly report disappointed investors.
Reports cited slower comparable sales growth and consumer-spending concerns.
The move dragged attention to broader retail-sector weakness.
articles.source: UOB Kay Hian / Reuters market summary

articles.title: Ross Stores jumps after raising full-year profit guidance
bullets: Ross Stores shares rose nearly 9% in premarket trading Friday.
The retailer raised annual earnings-per-share guidance to $8.61–$8.77.
It forecast stronger comparable sales than analysts expected for upcoming quarters.

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts sinks despite earnings beat
bullets: Advance Auto Parts reported adjusted EPS of $1.03, above analyst estimates.
Revenue of $2.0 billion missed consensus expectations.
Shares fell sharply as investors focused on weaker demand and revenue pressure.

articles.title: Deere rises after raising 2026 profit outlook
bullets: Deere raised its full-year net income forecast after quarterly profit rose.
Shares rose nearly 9% after the report.
The company cited AI-related construction demand and tariff refunds as tailwinds.

articles.title: Nvidia customers told AI server prices may rise more than 15%
bullets: Bloomberg reported some Nvidia customers were notified of AI-server price hikes above 15%.
The increases are tied partly to rising memory-chip costs.
Nvidia is scheduled to report second-quarter results on August 26.

articles.title: Alibaba plans $10.2 billion Hong Kong placement for AI spending
bullets: Alibaba said it plans to sell HK$80 billion in shares.
The proceeds are earmarked for full-stack AI capabilities.
Reuters said the deal would be the largest primary follow-on offering by a Hong Kong-listed company.

articles.title: Paramount seeks talks with California over Warner Bros. deal challenge
bullets: Paramount requested a preliminary meeting with California officials.
The state lawsuit seeks to stop Paramount’s acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery.
Opposing states argue the deal could reduce competition and raise prices.

articles.title: Canada’s Unifor and GM reach tentative agreements
bullets: Unifor and General Motors reached tentative agreements, Reuters reported Saturday.
The deal came amid broader Canada-US trade tensions.
Details were subject to union processes and member review.

articles.title: Deere raises outlook as construction demand offsets farm-equipment softness
bullets: Deere posted quarterly EPS of $5.10, beating analyst estimates.
Construction and forestry sales rose 18% from a year earlier.
The company lifted the lower end of its 2026 net income forecast.

articles.title: Vietnam approves customs-law changes to strengthen IP enforcement
bullets: Vietnam’s National Assembly approved customs-law amendments Sunday.
The changes expand enforcement against counterfeit and IP-infringing goods.
The revised law is set to take effect in March 2027.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: AI, robotics, space and technology policy stories

articles.title: Chinese humanoid robots beat Usain Bolt’s 100m world-record time
bullets: Tiangong Ultra ran 100 meters in 9.39 seconds at Beijing’s robot games.
Another robot, Lightning, finished in 9.47 seconds.
The games include sports and industrial-task contests for humanoid robots.

articles.title: Alibaba launches major share sale to fund AI buildout
bullets: Alibaba plans to raise about $10.2 billion through a Hong Kong placement.
The company said proceeds will support chips, infrastructure and AI models.
The financing reflects the continued scale of global AI infrastructure spending.

articles.title: Nvidia-linked AI server prices may rise as memory costs climb
bullets: Some large Nvidia customers were reportedly notified of price increases above 15%.
The hikes affect servers using Vera Rubin and Grace Blackwell systems, according to Bloomberg.
Reuters said it could not immediately verify the report.

articles.title: ISRO says Gaganyaan uncrewed test flight is nearing launch
bullets: ISRO’s chairman said the first uncrewed Gaganyaan mission could launch within four months.
The mission is a key step before India’s planned crewed spaceflight.
ISRO also outlined satellite, lunar, Venus and space-station ambitions.

articles.title: Vietnam strengthens customs tools against counterfeit tech and online trade
bullets: The amended customs law adds stronger IP enforcement powers at the border.
It also covers goods transiting Vietnam and e-commerce-platform trade.
The measure follows US scrutiny of Vietnam’s IP protection regime.
